card:
Port Hood village

Port Hood is the village at the centre of this map.

Port Hood Station Provincial Park

A picnic park with a cobble beach, next to a white sand beach. The coastal rail trail has a trailhead at Port Hood Station.

Port Hood wharf

Wharves reach out into Port Hood harbour here.

Murphys Pond breakwaters

Two breakwaters and a slipway stand at Murphys Pond, north of the village.

Little Judique Harbour

Fishing boats tie up at the harbour wharf. The coastal rail trail crosses the harbour on a causeway.

Pigs Cove

A slipway and a pier, with breakwaters, at Pigs Cove.

Port Hawkesbury

Port Hawkesbury is the town at the centre of this map.

Granville Green

A green with an outdoor stage on the town waterfront, beside a boardwalk.

Port Hawkesbury Community Park

A town park with a playground, a splash pad, a bicycle pump track and courts.

McNairs Cove

A park beside McNairs Cove, in Mulgrave, on the mainland shore of the strait.

Pirate Harbour

A small harbour with a pier, south of Mulgrave on the mainland shore.

Port Hastings

Port Hastings is where the coastal rail trail begins, just across the Canso Causeway on Cape Breton Island.

Port Hastings visitor information centre

The provincial visitor information centre in Port Hastings.

Troy Station trailhead

A trailhead of the coastal rail trail, with a rest stop and a view over St. Georges Bay.

Creignish

One of the communities the coastal rail trail passes between Port Hastings and Long Point.

Aulds Cove

A community and a cove on the mainland, across the strait from Port Hastings.

Judique village

Judique is the village at the centre of this map.

Baxters Cove

A slipway between two breakwaters, with a small navigation light.

Judique Flyer trailhead

A trailhead with a kiosk on the Judique Flyer section of the coastal rail trail.

Look-off above St. Georges Bay

A look-off with a rest stop and a wide view over St. Georges Bay.
